rule.statement: The High Court erred in law by admitting and relying upon a document marked 'P1' and further erred in attributing an admission to the Defendant regarding possession pursuant to it.
rule.supporting_quote: In light of the reasons above, I am of the view that the High Court erred in law by admitting and relying upon the document marked 'P1', and further erred in attributing an admission to the Defendant regarding possession pursuant to it.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 2 of the Prevention of Frauds Ordinance
